districts.name: The Drowned Quarter
districts.blurb: The lowest streets, never fully reclaimed from the flood of '71. Plank walkways over black water, houses with their first floors given to the tide, lantern-light rationed by the Syndicate. Where the case begins.

districts.name: The Spindles
districts.blurb: Forests of dead crane-towers and gutted textile mills along the old industrial waterfront. The Harbour Guild's heartland; rust, salt, and men who remember when the whistles still blew.

districts.name: The Gaslight Rows
districts.blurb: Where the Syndicate keeps the lights on and the merchant class keeps its head down. Neon over wet cobbles, reflections that look better than the things reflected. A different city after dark.
